title: Country Manager (Brazil)
description:
About the Client

Client is a fintech company building cross-border payments infrastructure using stablecoins to improve speed, cost efficiency, and global scalability.

The Role

Client is hiring a Country Manager to own the Brazil business end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role for someone who has built, run, and scaled a financial technology operation in Brazil before — and who sees stablecoins as the inevitable future of the country's payments infrastructure.

You will be the most senior executive in Brazil, responsible for the full scope of country operations: revenue growth, team building, regulatory positioning, partner relationships, and market strategy. You'll work directly with global leadership to define and execute Brazil's expansion roadmap, while serving as the primary face of Client to customers, regulators, and the broader ecosystem. Brazil is a top-priority market in Latin America. This role carries real weight and real autonomy

What You’ll Do

Own the Brazil P&L

  • Take full accountability for Brazil's revenue targets, cost base, and commercial performance
  • Build and execute a multi-year country growth strategy aligned with global objectives
  • Report directly to global leadership with full visibility into country-level metrics, pipeline, and operational health
  • Make resource allocation decisions for the Brazil business, including headcount, partnerships, and local investments

Build & Lead the Local Team

  • Hire, develop, and manage a high-performing local team across sales, business development, operations, and compliance
  • Create a culture of ownership, urgency, and customer focus
  • Partner with global HR, Finance, and Legal to build the right local infrastructure as the team scales
  • Serve as a player-coach in the early stages — willing to roll up your sleeves on deals, regulatory filings, and partner negotiations while the team is still being built

Drive Commercial Growth

  • Own the full go-to-market strategy for Brazil, targeting fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates
  • Personally lead and close strategic enterprise deals with senior finance, treasury, and payments leaders
  • Build and leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate pipeline and unlock key accounts
  • Develop and manage referral partnerships in the FX and banking sectors
  • Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage — articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities

Navigate Regulation, Compliance and Operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Brazilian regulators, including the Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) and CVM
  • Oversee the local compliance function and ensure operations remain aligned with Brazilian financial regulations, VASP frameworks, and AML/KYC requirements
  • Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape — Pix developments, crypto licensing, foreign exchange rules — and proactively adapt strategy
  • Coordinate with global Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to manage audits, licensing requirements, and regulatory filings
  • Build and maintain relationships with banking partners, payment providers, and required local infrastructure partners
  • Work with global and local teams to ensure customer success and operational execution

Represent Client in Market

  • Act as the most visible leader in Brazil — across events, conferences, media, and regulatory forums
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, partners, and ecosystem players
  • Provide global leadership with ongoing market intelligence: competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer needs
  • Contribute to broader LATAM strategy, with potential to expand scope over time

Influence Product & Strategy

  • Act as the voice of the Brazilian market internally — translating customer and regulatory needs into product direction
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure market fit
  • Help build the playbook for expansion in large emerging markets

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

  • 10- 15+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, or payments
  • 3–5+ years in a country management, general management, or senior leadership role in Brazil
  • Demonstrated track record of owning P&L and driving commercial growth
  • Deep expertise in Brazil’s payments and FX landscape — including cross-border flows, treasury operations, and regulatory environment (BCB, CVM)
  • Experience with crypto, stablecoins, or blockchain-enabled payments
  • Proven ability to hire, lead, and develop teams in a high-growth environment
  • Strong network with senior decision-makers across fintechs, banks, and PSPs in Brazil
  • Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance environments
  • Native Portuguese and professional English proficiency
  • Based in São Paulo with willingness to travel internationally

Nice to Have

  • Experience with leading financial institutions or high-growth fintechs
  • Experience engaging with regulators on licensing or compliance frameworks
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations

The Profile

  • You’ve owned and scaled a market, built teams, navigated regulators, and closed meaningful deals
  • You understand how Brazil operates — commercially, operationally, and culturally
  • You’re comfortable operating across executive, commercial, and regulatory environments
  • You bring structure to ambiguity while remaining adaptable
  • You believe in the evolution of payments infrastructure and want to lead that shift in Brazil

Compensation / Benefits

  • Total compensation includes base salary, commission, and equity

Desenvolvimento e otimização de métodos analíticos para quantificação de ingredientes ativos em suplementos alimentares.

title: Managing Director - Brazil (Crypto Payment Business)
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.

Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.

Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.

Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

description:

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Refatoração de IaC (Infrastructure as Code):

  • Lógica e Scripting: Conhecimento intermediário em lógica de programação para realizar ajustes em códigos de infraestrutura e entender fluxos de sistemas.

title: Analista de Automação e IA
description:
VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL EM CAXIAS DO SUL - RIO GRANDE DO SUL

Sobre a empresa:

Somos uma Martech com 3 anos de mercado, já contamos com mais de 1500 clientes espalhados pelo país, e buscamos crescer ainda mais atraindo profissionais de alta performance.

Objetivo do cargo:  

Buscamos um Analista em Automação e IA com foco em transformar processos operacionais em fluxos inteligentes. Sua missão é arquitetar soluções que conectem sistemas, bancos de dados e Inteligência Artificial, eliminando gargalos e garantindo a fluidez da informação. Você será responsável por diagnosticar ineficiências e implementar integrações que garantam agilidade e precisão.

Acreditamos que grandes soluções nascem de mentes inquietas. Por isso, garantimos o suporte necessário para o seu desenvolvimento, cultivando um espaço de trabalho colaborativo onde você tem liberdade para testar novas ideias e construir, junto conosco, o futuro das nossas automações.

Responsabilidades e Atividades:

Arquitetura e Criação de Automações: Desenhar, construir e gerenciar fluxos de automação utilizando plataformas low-code/no-code, com foco principal no n8n (e similares como Make ou Zapier).

Integração de Sistemas via API: Conectar e orquestrar diversas ferramentas corporativas por meio de APIs RESTful e Webhooks, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre plataformas como Slack, CRMs, ERPs, ferramentas de marketing e sistemas internos.

Gestão e Conexão de Dados: Integrar fluxos de automação com bancos de dados estruturados e não estruturados (ex: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase), garantindo o tráfego seguro, a validação e a atualização de informações em tempo real.

Implementação de Inteligência Artificial: Incorporar APIs de modelos de linguagem (LLMs como OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) aos fluxos de automação para tarefas como análise de dados, triagem de mensagens, geração de conteúdo e criação de agentes conversacionais.

Mapeamento de Processos: Trabalhar junto às equipes de negócios para identificar gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de automação.

Manutenção e Monitoramento: Realizar troubleshooting (solução de problemas), debugar erros de integração, monitorar o consumo de APIs e otimizar fluxos existentes para garantir alta disponibilidade e redução de custos operacionais.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação concluída ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência com Ferramentas de Automação: Domínio avançado na criação de fluxos em n8n (essencial), ou ferramentas equivalentes.

Domínio de APIs e Integrações: Conhecimento sólido sobre como funcionam APIs REST, Webhooks, autenticação (OAuth2, API Keys) e manipulação de dados em formato JSON.

Conhecimento de Banco de Dados: Experiência prática em conectar e manipular dados no Supabase (BaaS) ou conhecimentos em SQL/NoSQL.

Lógica de Programação: Capacidade de escrever pequenos scripts para transformação de dados dentro das plataformas de automação (conhecimento em JavaScript/Node.js ou Python é um grande diferencial).

Familiaridade com IA: Conhecimento prático na utilização de prompts e integração via API com modelos de Inteligência Artificial.

Diferenciais:  

Vivência em empresas de tecnologia ( SaaS, Startups, Cloud entre outras ), compreendendo a dinâmica de crescimento acelerado e entrega contínua.

Capacidade de criar dashboards de performance para monitorar a saúde das automações.

title: Remote Kotlin / Java Backend Developer
description:
At Scanz, we are on a mission to bring magic back to trading software - specifically for active traders (aka day traders). To empower traders to do their best trading, we are building a next-generation Trader Analytics Platform that combines UI elegance with world-class real time performance. Founded in 2004, Scanz has become the platform of choice for 40,000+ traders to identify, plan and make their trades.

Scanz is a fully remote company. Today, our small but mighty team is distributed across North America, South America, Europe and Australia. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and our passion for software craftsmanship. We care deeply about the quality of our work.

As a very small team, we’re all generalists and constantly picking up new challenges. When it comes to code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick a problem and solve it. We use Kotlin, TypeScript and React to build a highly-scalable system so we can continuously make progress on a solid foundation. We don’t expect you to have a background in everything we use, but we do expect strong Java fundamentals (Kotlin even better) and a background working with React and TypeScript.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement server-side logic using Spring Webflux and Kotlin.
  • Build robust, reliable, fault-tolerant data pipelines that process millions of operations daily.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
  • Develop and maintain APIs, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to database design and implementation (PostgreSQL).
  • Improve the system's throughput and incorporate performance testing into our CI pipelines.
  • Scale services horizontally.
  • Contribute to weekly standup.

Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin / Java.
  • Proficiency with Kotlin coroutines (flows).
  • Proficiency with Spring Webflux and Reactive Streams back pressure.
  • Self-motivated developer comfortable working as a core member on an A-list team of backend and frontend developers split over different time zones.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills within an asynchronous environment (Slack, Loom).
  • Deep-level understanding of distributed systems and how to make fault-tolerant applications.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Strong familiarity with database systems, particularly PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable using AWS and cloud computing platforms.
  • Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, specifically unit, integration, and E2E tests.
  • Readiness and desire to participate in code reviews.
  • We're hiring across Americas and European time zones

Tech Stack

Back End

  • Kotlin
  • Spring Webflux
  • Ktor Server
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • RSocket
  • Ktor Client
  • Kotlinx Serialization
  • Quartz
  • Kotest + JUnit
  • Gradle

Front End

  • Kotlin Multiplatform
  • React (with hooks)
  • SharedWorker
  • TypeScript
  • NPM
  • Gradle

Infrastructure

  • AWS + S3
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Jenkins
  • Github

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.

Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.

Location:

Brazil, Mexico

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues
  • Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required
  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment
  • Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads
  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities
  • Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing
  • Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only
  • Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations

What we expect:

  • Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems
  • Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments
  • Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns
  • Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing
  • Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE
  • Working knowledge of the AIX command line
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours
  • Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments
  • Background in data centre or scientific computing environments
  • Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale
  • Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis

We offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs
  • Strong management and tech expertise

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.

  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
About Optibus:

is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.

About the position:

We are looking for a Customer Success Engineer to join our global Customer Success team! Based in São Paulo, Brazil , this person will play a key role as the central technical partner for our customers. From onboarding new clients, helping reach their initial desired value promptly, to ensuring they achieve continuous, measurable value from the Optibus platform at every stage of their journey.

Our CSEs are Optibus subject matter experts who bridge the gap between customer business goals and our technology. They guide our customers towards value realisation, including adoption of the platform, strategic technical enablement, solution design, integrations, running workshops, providing technical coaching, and collaborating cross-functionally across the business to drive long-term customer success. You will work closely with our wider team, including Support, PMO, in addition to Revenue (including Account Managers AMs and Pre-sales Engineers), Product, R&D, and other cross-functional departments.

This is a role with a strong client-facing component. You’ll be expected to spend at least three days per week working from a local Optibus office or on-site with customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Enablement

  • Initial Implementation : Own the technical project delivery, managing data migration, initial platform configuration, and foundational user training to ensure a timely and effective go-live.
  • Continuous Enablement : Deliver staged technical enablement and coaching sessions based on the customer's maturity and specific business goals.

Value Focused

  • Value Realization : Plan and lead value-focused technical workshops, such as optimization scenario analysis, to demonstrate measurable value received and drive deeper platform adoption, as the technical partner supporting CSM/SCSE.

Configuration & Technical Requirements

  • Solution Design & Integrations : Work closely with clients and internal teams (Project Managers, R&D, Product, Solutions Architects) to define technical requirements and translate them into platform configurations.
  • Technical Expertise : Manage technical aspects of integrations with client systems and serve as the subject matter expert on platform capabilities.

Relationship Management

  • Relationship Building : Act as a trusted technical advisor, building strong, lasting relationships with technical users, stakeholders, and internal decision-makers.
  • Client Mapping : Maintain a deep understanding of the client’s organizational structures and technical landscape to ensure mutual technical goals are accomplished and risks are mitigated.

Customer Delivery

  • Project & Task Management : Working alongside the PMO/CSM, ensure all technical activities adhere to the project scope within budget, and are delivered efficiently and on time, from initial implementation through ongoing technical services.

Voice of the Customer

  • Technical ambassador : Represent the customer internally, collecting and analyzing feedback to inform the Product and R&D roadmap.
  • Escalation Management : Manage internal technical escalations with R&D, Product, and Support counterparts to ensure swift resolution of complex issues.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment : Collaborate with the wider Customer Success, Sales, and Product teams to align technical delivery with the overall customer success plan.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Adherence to Project SOWs and task completion estimates
  • Time to First Value (TTFV)
  • CSAT (Customer Satisfaction)
  • Utilisation
  • Time capture

Requirements:

  • Proven experience and measurable success in client-facing roles within SaaS (ideally vertical), with either B2B and/or B2G experience.
  • Proven track record of building strong relationships within a client portfolio with their technical and non-technical teams.
  • Exceptional ability to manage time-based projects, prioritize effectively, and drive technical outcomes across multiple client engagements simultaneously.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Proven experience of adaptability in fast-paced start up/scale up environments.
  • (Very) nice to have: experience in transit, public transportation, CAD/AVL, and/or ITS.
  • Please submit your CV in English for consideration!

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — AWS Serverless (Remote)
description:
About EverUp

We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features.

The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web.

What you’ll do

  • Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway ( & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ; implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/
  • Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.
  • Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms.
  • Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions.
  • Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.
  • Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).

Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

  • 8+ years building/maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.
  • Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).
  • Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline).
  • Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP).
  • WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features.
  • Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations.
  • Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.
  • Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure.

How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call
  2. Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution)
  3. Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario)
  4. Founder/lead chat & references

Equal opportunity

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective.

How to apply

Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.

Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de Manutenção - Aciaria
description:

Inovação, Tecnologia e Excelência.

Com mais de 120 anos de história , presença em 20 países nos cinco continentes e mais de 13.000 empregados , estamos na vanguarda da tecnologia e da sustentabilidade.

Nossa atuação abrange:

✅ Indústria – tubos resistentes e leves para diversas aplicações

Florestal – produção de carvão vegetal para abastecimento dos altos-fornos

⛏ Mineração – fornecimento interno de minério de ferro

Com presença global e forte atuação local, nosso objetivo é estar cada vez mais próximo dos clientes , garantindo competitividade, inovação e excelência .

Resumo da posição:

Como Gerente de Manutenção , você terá um papel fundamental na garantia da alta disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos de Pelotização, Alto‑Forno e Aciaria. Será responsável por assegurar o alcance das metas de desempenho da área, otimizar custos de manutenção e promover um ambiente de trabalho alinhado aos valores e prioridades do negócio.

Atuará como referência técnica e de liderança na Gerência de Manutenção Upstream, oferecendo suporte estratégico aos clientes internos e contribuindo diretamente para a redução dos índices de gravidade e frequência de acidentes. Principais responsabilidades:

  • Assegurar a confiabilidade dos ativos por meio de planejamento, inspeções e execução de manutenções preventivas;
  • Alinhar a estratégia de manutenção às diretrizes corporativas, garantindo a contribuição efetiva para o cumprimento dos planos de produção, com foco em segurança, qualidade, otimização de custos e melhoria contínua;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento e o engajamento da equipe, estimulando o aprimoramento técnico e comportamental da equipe.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, Elétrica, Automação ou afins;
  • Inglês Avançado (exposição relevante junto ao nível global);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de manutenção das áreas das áreas de Pelotização, Alto-Forno e Aciaria;
  • Atuação anterior consistente em gestão de equipes de manutenção, em nível similar a posição referente;
  • Conhecimento/utilização consistente de ferramentas de confiabilidade e controle de manutenção;
  • Experiência com orçamento de manutenção, através da gestão e controle de custos e planejamento estratégico;
  • Atuação anterior com projetos de melhoria contínua, assim como conhecimento das ferramentas de gestão da qualidade.

Benefícios oferecidos:

Nosso compromisso é oferecer a você um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e seguro, onde seu talento possa alcançar o máximo potencial. Para isso, disponibilizamos um pacote de benefícios completo e pensado para garantir qualidade de vida, bem-estar e desenvolvimento contínuo.

  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação.
  • Ambiente inovador e oportunidades de carreira global.

Se você busca um ambiente global , dinâmico e com oportunidades de crescimento, a Vallourec é o lugar certo para você!

description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?

About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.

What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.
  • 3+ years within a SaaS company.
  • Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.
  • Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.
  • Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.
  • Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.
  • Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.

✨ Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals.

⚡️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off)
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don’t Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You’re not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don’t meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We’re looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that’s you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno (SQL e Phyton)
description:
Atuar de forma analítica e autônoma na construção e análise do posicionamento financeiro, garantindo consistência, confiabilidade e clareza das informações que suportam decisões operacionais e táticas. Garante que os números estejam corretos, explicáveis e utilizáveis. Nesta posição você terá atuação com SQL e Phyton e por isso será considerado um diferencial.

1) Validação e Evolução dos Fluxos de Posicionamento

  • Validar os fluxos de posicionamento existentes, avaliando impactos operacionais, financeiros e sistêmicos.
  • Propor, desenhar e implementar novos fluxos de posicionamento para novos parceiros, produtos ou modelos de negócio.
  • Atuar na definição de regras operacionais e critérios financeiros para posicionamento, conciliação e faturamento.
  • Documentar fluxos, regras e exceções, garantindo padronização e escalabilidade da operação.

2) Posicionamento e Conciliação de Reservas

  • Analisar e consolidar arquivos de reservas enviados por locadoras e/ou parceiros, garantindo consistência e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Conduzir conciliações de média e alta complexidade, investigando causas-raiz de divergências e definindo soluções.
  • Validar entregas para o fechamento contábil.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas juniores nas rotinas de posicionamento.

3) Receita, Faturamento e Impacto no Negócio

  • Validar critérios de reconhecimento de receita, assegurando correta aplicação conforme contratos e regras contábeis.
  • Avaliar impactos financeiros de exceções operacionais, novos produtos e ajustes de fluxo.
  • Garantir o correto faturamento das operações, atuando em casos não padronizados.
  • Apoiar análises financeiras que subsidiem decisões do negócio.

4) Controles, Conciliações e Qualidade da Informação

  • Validar conciliações financeiras e operacionais nos sistemas (SAP e demais plataformas).
  • Estruturar e aprimorar controles financeiros e planilhas de conciliação, com foco em confiabilidade e eficiência.
  • Analisar variações relevantes e definir ações corretivas junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Atuar de forma ativa no suporte ao fechamento mensal, garantindo qualidade das informações.

5) Programas, Relatórios e Atuação Multidisciplinar

  • Ser responsável pela validação financeira e operacional de programas específicos (pontos, afiliados, receitas recorrentes).
  • Elaborar e validar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho da frente de posicionamento e caixa.
  • Conduzir homologações de sistemas, novos fluxos e correções operacionais.
  • Atuar junto ao time de Legal na análise de cláusulas financeiras, avaliando impactos no fluxo operacional e no posicionamento.

title: Product Owner
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Escrever e manter histórias de usuário claras , completas e orientadas a valor.
  • Definir critérios de aceitação objetivos e testáveis para cada história.
  • Refinar continuamente o backlog, garantindo que os itens estejam prontos para desenvolvimento ( Definition of Ready ).
  • Priorizar o backlog de acordo com valor para o negócio, necessidades do usuário e viabilidade técnica .
  • Alinhar o backlog com a visão do produto e o roadmap .
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review e retrospectiva).
  • Esclarecer dúvidas da equipe durante o sprint para garantir fluidez na entrega.
  • Trabalhar junto ao Scrum Master e à Equipe de Entrega no plano de execução.
  • Proteger a equipe contra demandas fora do escopo do sprint .
  • Equilibrar itens de entrega de valor , dívida técnica e facilitadores técnicos .
  • Colaborar com arquitetos e líderes técnicos para:
  • Definir necessidades de infraestrutura.
  • Priorizar trabalhos técnicos e arquiteturais.
  • Dividir grandes iniciativas técnicas em histórias menores , que entreguem valor incremental ao usuário.
  • Validar se os lançamentos realmente geram valor para os usuários e para o negócio .
  • Coletar e analisar feedback dos usuários após os releases.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho do produto e propor ajustes.
  • Dialogar diretamente com os usuários sobre resultados, uso e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Atuar como a voz do cliente dentro da equipe.
  • Interagir com usuários para entender necessidades, dores e objetivos.
  • Analisar demandas recebidas, garantindo entendimento claro dos resultados esperados.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de Programa no roteiro do produto e planos de lançamento .
  • Alinhar expectativas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Colaborar com outros Product Owners para:

Gerenciar dependências entre produtos e times.

Garantir alinhamento de prioridades.

Participar de fóruns de sincronização entre equipes quando necessário.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Inglês Avançado/fluente
  • Vivência como Product Owner
  • Vivência com Metodologias Ágeis

title: Facilities Specialist-Fire Protection System
description:
Especialista em Sistemas de Proteção contra Incêndio – Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Coordenação de Projetos

SolutionMall | Brasil (Remoto / Meio Período / Modelo de Cooperação)

1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada em produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria.

Não atuamos como um marketplace tradicional. Nosso foco é a entrega estruturada de soluções em nível de sistema, conectando análise de demanda, coordenação de soluções, seleção de produtos, suporte à entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Na área de proteção contra incêndio, a SolutionMall já trabalha com uma estrutura mais ampla de soluções, e não apenas com uma única linha de produto. O portfólio inclui categorias como:

  • mini estações de incêndio
  • extintores de incêndio
  • luzes de saída de emergência
  • alarmes de emergência
  • gabinetes de combate a incêndio

Esse conjunto é apoiado por catálogo de produtos, materiais técnicos e playbooks comerciais, o que torna esta posição mais adequada para alguém com visão comercial e capacidade de coordenação, e não apenas para um perfil técnico tradicional.

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos buscando um Especialista em Sistemas de Proteção contra Incêndio – Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Coordenação de Projetos para apoiar a expansão da SolutionMall no Brasil .

Esta é uma função remota, de meio período e baseada em cooperação . Não se trata de um cargo interno convencional de escritório em tempo integral. Procuramos alguém que possa atuar de forma flexível com a SolutionMall para apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado
  • acompanhamento de clientes
  • prospecção e evolução de oportunidades de projeto
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • apoio em cotações, pedidos e coordenação de entrega

Esta posição não é destinada a um engenheiro puramente de execução, nem a um vendedor tradicional sem base técnica. O perfil ideal é alguém com alguma familiaridade com sistemas de proteção contra incêndio e produtos relacionados, mas que também saiba desenvolver relacionamento comercial, acompanhar oportunidades e ajudar a transformar demandas em negócios reais.

3) Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Mercado e Expansão Comercial

  • Desenvolver oportunidades de negócios no mercado brasileiro relacionadas a sistemas de proteção contra incêndio, segurança contra incêndio e produtos de apoio para emergências
  • Apoiar ações de promoção de mercado, negociação comercial, desenvolvimento de clientes e acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • Identificar clientes potenciais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros, revendedores e parceiros locais
  • Ajudar a transformar contatos iniciais e interesses de mercado em RFQs qualificados e discussões reais de projeto

Esse escopo está alinhado ao modelo de cooperação atual da SolutionMall, no qual parceiros locais são autorizados a atuar em promoção de mercado, negociação, desenvolvimento de clientes e rastreamento de oportunidades.

Relacionamento com Clientes e Acompanhamento de Oportunidades

  • Manter contato com clientes potenciais e partes interessadas em projetos
  • Acompanhar necessidades, escopo básico, intenção de compra e contexto dos projetos
  • Apoiar a coleta de informações iniciais para avaliação interna e coordenação comercial
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre o mercado local e as equipes da SolutionMall

Comunicação Técnica e Alinhamento de Soluções

  • Ter entendimento básico das aplicações e categorias de produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • Apoiar a comunicação sobre grupos de produtos como:
  • extintores de incêndio
  • mini estações de incêndio
  • iluminação de saída de emergência
  • alarmes de emergência
  • gabinetes de combate a incêndio
  • Ajudar a conectar as necessidades do cliente com categorias de produtos, materiais técnicos e direções de solução adequadas
  • Coordenar com as equipes da SolutionMall o esclarecimento de requisitos e o alinhamento técnico-comercial básico

Esse escopo técnico acompanha a estrutura atual do suite de proteção contra incêndio da SolutionMall, que reúne catálogo, recursos técnicos e playbooks de vendas em um mesmo sistema.

Acompanhamento de Projetos, RFQs e Pedidos

  • Acompanhar oportunidades desde a fase inicial de contato até RFQs, cotações, confirmação de projeto e suporte ao pedido
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento do status de propostas, feedback do cliente, próximos passos e evolução da oportunidade
  • Coordenar com a SolutionMall a verificação do projeto, o order docking e o follow-up comercial posterior
  • Ajudar a manter visibilidade clara sobre quais oportunidades estão ativas e têm maior potencial de avanço

Esse papel também reflete o modelo atual de cooperação, que exige atualização de progresso de mercado, conversão de RFQs e apoio no acompanhamento comercial e de pedidos.

Canais, Parceiros e Feedback de Mercado

  • Construir e manter relacionamento com parceiros locais, distribuidores, traders, empreiteiros e contatos relevantes do setor
  • Compartilhar informações de mercado sobre preços, concorrência, preferências dos clientes, condições de entrega e tendências de projeto
  • Ajudar a SolutionMall a fortalecer sua compreensão do mercado brasileiro e aprimorar sua estratégia regional

4) Qualificações

Obrigatórias

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:
  • produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • sistemas de segurança contra incêndio
  • equipamentos relacionados a emergência
  • vendas técnicas ou vendas de projetos
  • desenvolvimento de negócios
  • coordenação técnico-comercial
  • Capacidade de apoiar desenvolvimento de clientes e acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • Entendimento básico sobre aplicações de produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • Boa comunicação tanto em discussões comerciais quanto técnicas
  • Conforto para atuar em um modelo flexível, de meio período e orientado à cooperação
  • Inglês funcional para trabalho

Desejáveis

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de mercado ou visitas a clientes no Brasil
  • Familiaridade com distribuidores, integradores, compradores de projeto, empreiteiros ou canais relacionados
  • Experiência com produtos como extintores, iluminação de emergência, alarmes, gabinetes ou itens correlatos
  • Capacidade de apoiar tanto expansão comercial quanto acompanhamento prático de oportunidades
  • Português fluente
  • Espanhol ou outro idioma regional será um diferencial

5) Cobertura

Esta função é focada no mercado brasileiro e apoia o desenvolvimento local relacionado a:

  • produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • soluções de segurança contra incêndio
  • produtos de apoio para emergência
  • oportunidades comerciais e de fornecimento ligadas a projetos

Dependendo das necessidades reais do mercado e dos projetos, o profissional poderá apoiar diferentes regiões do Brasil.

6) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma função de meio período , dentro de um modelo de cooperação de longo prazo .

Buscamos alguém que possa colaborar com a SolutionMall de forma contínua e prática, contribuindo com:

  • expansão de mercado
  • acompanhamento de leads
  • coordenação com clientes e parceiros
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • follow-up de RFQs e propostas
  • suporte a pedidos e entregas

Esse formato está alinhado ao modelo internacional de parceria da SolutionMall, baseado em desenvolvimento regional, oportunidades verificadas e crescimento de negócios orientado a resultados.

7) Remuneração

A remuneração é baseada em desempenho e contribuição real .

Ela poderá considerar fatores como:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • conversão de RFQs
  • participação em coordenação de projetos
  • resultados comerciais e pedidos fechados

O modelo de cooperação da SolutionMall já prevê uma lógica de crescimento de longo prazo, com suporte ao desenvolvimento comercial e estrutura comissionada conforme a evolução das oportunidades e dos projetos.

8) Como se Candidatar

Opção 1

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn com uma breve introdução sobre sua experiência relevante, por exemplo:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios em proteção contra incêndio
  • acompanhamento de projetos de fire safety
  • desenvolvimento de canais locais
  • suporte comercial para produtos de emergência
  • coordenação técnico-comercial

Opção 2

title: AI Creative Producer
description:
❗ Please make sure to complete the form and apply for this position using the Easy Apply button on LinkedIn as well - otherwise, your application will not be considered.

❗ Fluency in English and the ability to work within the European (CET) time zone are mandatory requirements for this position.

About Us

Prime Insights connects millions of users worldwide through our proprietary market research panel apps. Our technology powers a global community, delivering a world-class experience for members and actionable, data-driven insights for clients.

We’re building the next generation of our product ecosystem with AI at its core. Our mission is simple: use cutting-edge technology to create better user experiences and smarter business outcomes. We move fast, experiment often, and value people who build, test, and iterate.

Overview

We run a portfolio of rewarded apps used by millions of people, and we use AI to produce the creative that acquires them. We're looking for someone who sees AI tools the way a craftsperson sees their workshop — not as a shortcut, but as a way to make better things faster. You'll produce across formats: playable ads, UGC videos, animated gameplays, motion graphics, and statics. The through-line is taste. The output is yours.

What you'll produce

  • Playable ads - HTML5 interactive ads via our in-house AI generator
  • UGC video - AI-generated or AI-directed scripts, hooks, and edits
  • Animated gameplay - motion-based app demo ads and screen recordings
  • Statics & motion - banner ads, animated creatives, app store assets

What you'll own

  • Generating and art directing assets across formats using AI image, video, and motion tools
  • Running our playable ad generator - concepting mechanics, reviewing output, shipping network variants
  • Maintaining quality across a high volume of creative - knowing when something is ready and when it needs another pass
  • Staying sharp on what's working - feeding performance signals back into your creative decisions

You might be a fit if

  • You have a strong visual sensibility - you notice when something's slightly off and you fix it before anyone asks
  • You're fluent with AI creative tools - different LLM’s, Veo3, NanoBanana, Runway, Kling, Sora, or whatever's best for a specific task in hand
  • You've made things across multiple formats - not just one medium - and you can show us the decisions behind them
  • You're comfortable owning output end-to-end in a small, fast-moving team

Your Background

You come from a creative discipline - video editing, motion design, graphic design, art direction, or something adjacent. You know what good looks like because you've spent time making things, not just prompting things. AI tools are an extension of that craft, not a replacement for it.

  • Video editor — you understand pacing, hooks, and what makes a cut land
  • Motion designer or animator — you have a feel for timing, transitions, and visual rhythm
  • Graphic designer or art director — you compose, you direct, you know when to stop
  • Any combination of the above — the through-line is a trained eye

Nice to have

  • Background in mobile gaming, casual apps, or performance marketing creative
  • Familiarity with UA networks — AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, Google UAC
  • Some comfort reading or debugging HTML and JavaScript

Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .
